description: Explicit exceptions to 'board UI state lives in board-state.mjs'. scripts/scan-board-state.mjs fails on any let/var, new Map/Set/WeakMap/WeakSet, mutable top-level const literal or web-storage use in apps/board/*.mjs that is not listed here with the exact occurrence count. for-loop counters are exempt by rule. Application state (session, navigation, selection, editor, dialogs, drafts, caches, photo review, workspace status, search/mention cursors, pending tasks) must be a state-lib scope owner, ids, epoch or resource in board-state.mjs, never an entry here.

entries.name: paths
entries.why: Read-only table of SVG icon path strings; never written after module evaluation and not application state.

entries.name: value
entries.why: api(): response-body local that lives for one awaited request; not shared and not UI state.

entries.name: at
entries.why: linkedText(): cursor of one synchronous string render; discarded when the function returns.

entries.name: out
entries.why: linkedText(): HTML accumulator of one synchronous string render; discarded when the function returns.

entries.name: (expression)
entries.why: profile(): new Set(...).size counts distinct board ids inside one render template; a pure temporary.

entries.name: toggleDone
entries.why: Declarative command definition (library-owned defineJsonCommand input); read-only, the document mutates only through the store.

entries.name: COMMANDS
entries.why: Name-to-definition lookup of the declarative commands; read-only.

entries.name: DOCUMENT_BACKENDS
entries.why: Closed list of backend names used for validation; never mutated.

entries.name: BUILD_BACKENDS
entries.why: Closed list of backend names used for validation; never mutated.

entries.name: tasks
entries.why: Infrastructure registry of the debounced tasks so resetPrivate can cancel them; not UI state and never serialized.

entries.name: result
entries.why: commitDocumentAction(): local result of one synchronous commit, not shared state.

entries.name: observerFailure
entries.why: commitDocumentAction(): captures a post-commit observer failure for one call; not shared state.

entries.name: value
entries.why: Default plainCell for standalone use of createPhotoReviewSession; the board always passes the photoReview scope owner instead.

entries.name: submission
entries.why: reviewPhoto submit handler local; holds one in-flight submission token, whose state of record is the session owner.

entries.name: active
entries.why: deepFreeze(): recursion-path WeakSet created for one synchronous cache admission, discarded when that validation returns; not a cross-action state owner or persistent cache.
